en: This postcard displays a sepia-toned image of a residential European street with ornate historic buildings on the left. Prominently on the right is a statue of a man in military attire on a pedestal inscribed with the name 'BISMARCK', surrounded by trees and bushes. A few people are walking or standing along the street, suggesting an early 20th-century urban scene. At the top, printed text reads: 'Nossen i. Sa. Bismarck-Denkmal.'
